title: Legacy/offline
steps: Prepare v1 sketches and a new blank board. Disable network and do not enable any model. Reopen, draw with finger and mouse, save/reopen, erase the final stroke, undo/redo, and Cancel an edit.
expected: Original v1 geometry survives untouched saves; edited geometry and empty existing sketches persist correctly; Cancel preserves the saved object. No provider, Bluetooth or proprietary-driver dependency.

title: Physical pen
steps: On an actual pressure pen/tablet, draw light/heavy strokes, vary supported tilt, hover, use eraser end and barrel button, place a palm, then pan/zoom/select with touch. Repeat after pen detach/reattach.
expected: Pressure and eraser have their documented meaning; unsupported axes fall back; no palm stroke, connected-pointer jump, accidental erase or blocked accessibility gesture. Record exact hardware/OS/driver.

title: Recovery/capacity
steps: Create completed and incomplete contacts. Rotate, background/foreground, terminate/restart the app, and restore a completed draft. Attempt a large drawing up to each quota; import corrupt/future input in the isolated fixture.
expected: Completed local recovery survives; incomplete contact is discarded; exact draft receipt prevents stale resurrection; bounded history/payload/points and truthful limit notice; no silent loss or crash.

title: Tablet/accessibility
steps: Repeat phone/tablet portrait/landscape, 100%/200% font, TalkBack, keyboard undo/redo and reduced motion in EN/LV/RU/PL. Run a 30-minute drawing session and record frame/memory trends.
expected: Workspace and controls stay usable, focus/order/labels work, geometry and transforms stay stable, memory remains bounded. Synthetic MotionEvents are separate evidence from the physical pen.

title: Exact source
steps: Select two visibly distinct drawn regions and one annotated PDF page. Ask about each, save a bookmark, reopen/rotate/zoom, move the source, then edit/delete/relink it and retry the old selection.
expected: Every answer/bookmark references the exact object/page/strokes/revision; stale or deleted sources require reselection; a different selection cannot be substituted.

title: Real mixed voice
steps: Select a region physically, speak an instruction through the actual STT-final route, then change selection during a delayed request and repeat with an ambiguous referent.
expected: One authorized interaction binds speech and exact selected region; changed or ambiguous references clarify; no action or unrelated source is inferred from a pen gesture.

title: Privacy/failure
steps: Use Private/offline and unavailable OCR/vision, then deny provider consent; repeat with a permitted direct user-owned provider and cancel while cropping/transcribing.
expected: Local markup/selection still works; no unapproved content transfer; crop is bounded and source-scoped; failures/cancellation release resources and explain the actual limitation.

title: Study/localization
steps: Run question → learner attempt → hint → feedback → revision → save/resume from ink, image/PDF and a voice memo. Inspect source-linked transcription and EN/LV/RU/PL limitations at phone/tablet sizes.
expected: Guidance remains distinct from giving the answer; context/provenance and privacy decision remain inspectable; unsupported language/recognizer is not advertised as supported. Record latency/memory.

title: Pair and draw
steps: First verify the production activation gate stays closed. In the explicit qualification host configuration, exchange public device files directly between an Android tablet and a second host; confirm trust locally on both. Start one exact saved sketch through the approved current interaction, export/open its connection file, draw pressure strokes and erase, and read back the remote editable sketch.
expected: No pairing/receive/write path bypasses the gate. Mutual TLS authenticates exact approved certificates; input/display/processing owners are distinct; strokes converge once and remain editable. A fixture loopback pass is not two-device acceptance.

title: Transport abuse
steps: Use the host test harness to repeat/reorder/drop complete checkpoints and previews, send oversized/future/stale/source/session/interaction/document mismatches, flood previews, and use an untrusted or replaced certificate. Cancel while another checkpoint holds the owner lock.
expected: No unauthenticated injection or tool invocation; bounded frames/rate/queues; duplicate gets the original receipt; stale/conflicting content is rejected; incomplete preview expires; cancellation closes sockets and removes session/context.

title: Recover/conflict
steps: Disconnect during a contact and after commit before receipt; sleep/wake and restart both hosts. Keep editing locally, explicitly resume using a fresh session, create simultaneous local editor/recovery edits, and repeat identical IDs under two trusted hosts.
expected: Local completed edits remain recoverable; no automatic external-action replay or duplicate stroke; explicit revision conflict instead of overwrite; recovery is scoped to authenticated host; revoked/expired grants cannot resume silently.

title: Voice and lifecycle
steps: Select on one endpoint and speak on another in the same authorized interaction. Retry in a different interaction, after edit, after Stop/forget, after background and after process death. Inspect Devices capabilities and use accessible Stop.
expected: Only the exact current authorized session/region resolves; pen input never grants app/tool/cloud permission. Connected is separate from started/saved; local drawing remains available after disconnect.

title: Platforms/performance
steps: Build each native host adapter on its actual target. Test one exact Windows pen and one explicitly selected Linux evdev pen, recording driver/architecture. Investigate each Huion/OpenTabletDriver/Pi configuration independently. Measure end-to-end pen-to-preview/commit latency, memory/queue ceiling, loss/duplication, 30-minute thermal and battery use on tablet + second host.
expected: Compatibility records distinguish SOURCE_ONLY/NOT_TESTED/PASS/FAIL/UNSUPPORTED. Preserve supported pressure/eraser; never claim Windows/Linux/Huion/Pi hardware support from Android, source review or loopback tests. Attach actual measurements and predeclared budgets.

title: Controlled benchmark
steps: Inventory installed artifacts only. For each selected exact artifact/quantization/context/settings, collect five cold and at least thirty warm serial-baseline and Auto runs, plus CPU/GPU manual pins. Record actual effective backend, delegate placement/fallback, load/prefill/decode/TTFT, RSS, thermal, failure and stage trace IDs.
expected: Same-input comparison is reproducible. Compute/report median/p95 end-of-speech to actual first audible audio, full latency and success rate; Auto must improve both median/p95 without correctness loss. Init alone is not GPU placement proof.

title: Concurrency/safety
steps: Overlap STT partials, retrieval and useful warmup; issue a final native command; barge in during generation/playback; cancel during admission/load, force eviction/low-memory on a test device, and detach BT/glasses. Repeat local and permitted direct-cloud routes.
expected: Independent stages overlap and dependent/authorized effects serialize. Partial/ambiguous ASR never acts; no duplicate action or stale audio. Native fast path avoids heavy LLM; unsupported backends reject; residency/thermal/memory limits and permissions hold.

title: Consumer setup
steps: Install/repair a supported curated role pack through normal setup; inspect Advanced role/backend/residency controls and switch back to consumer defaults.
expected: Role-to-model and model-to-backend remain independent, no prewarm-all policy or RAM-only promise; existing providers/setup work. No CI/Actions are run.

title: Native capability
steps: For the exact installed supported SHA/runtime, inspect native embedding task/modalities/backend/encoder packaging before allocation. Test invalid/imported/unsupported modality/backend requests and cancellation during admission/close.
expected: Only actual supported native combinations allocate; unknown/imported capability stays untrusted; text-only fallback is honest; resource/physical-artifact leases release on cancellation and failed close reconciles.

title: Multimodal quality
steps: Prelabel positive/negative text-image, image-image, text-audio and text-video fixtures. Run supported native requests on exact bytes and report similarity ranking, latency/RSS, cold/warm behavior and low-memory/model-switch cases.
expected: Expected positives beat declared hard negatives; report actual quality and failures. Unsupported inputs remain explicitly unqualified, never generative vision or a fabricated vector. Raw input never silently uploads.

title: Index/consumer
steps: Opt in a local working set; exercise Notebook picture search, Canvas visual find, Study retrieval and voice-memo search. Change encoder/SHA/dimension/normalization/preprocessing/frame policy; reindex, delete/revoke source and retry.
expected: Incompatible spaces never mix; source permissions/deletion are honored; safe migration/reindex and bounded decoders/frames. Consumer flows have genuine retrieval evidence, not only a diagnostic engine pass.

title: Privacy/languages
steps: Repeat offline, permission denial and interruption; inspect EN/RU/LV/PL copy and phone/tablet/large-text UI.
expected: No cloud fallback or unsupported language/vision promise; clear local-search benefits and truthful limitations. Metrics stay in Advanced.

title: Real intent matrix
steps: Use intent-classification-v1.json: all 48 fixture IDs across EN/RU/LV/PL by keyboard and actual spoken STT-final input. Keep negations, quotes, indirect requests, questions and composite actions. Capture fixture ID, recognized-route correctness, expected/actual label, model SHA, warm/cold and p95.
expected: Labels conform without thinking leakage; final text alone cannot authorize an action. Record the known prior warm Qwen failure as historical FAIL until a changed implementation/configuration produces new evidence. Admission skips do not count as classifier success.

title: Action loop/markup
steps: Execute native and registered cross-tool requests with approvals denied/allowed, duplicated proposals and ambiguous/UNCERTAIN output. Inspect streamed chat, TTS and stored reply for malformed/partial HALO_PROMPT envelopes.
expected: No wrong/duplicate side effect, partial ASR action or hidden marker leakage; normal text still streams; uncertainty clarifies and missing planner setup is honest.

title: Selection/residency
steps: Enable a qualified intent model, restart, change/remove the package, compete with STT/TTS/chat and switch low-memory residency; deny setup/permissions and retry.
expected: Opt-in state is accurate; bounded intent admission never replaces a competing resident; stale/failed/unknown evidence cannot resurrect a positive recommendation; no cloud fallback.

title: Ten real turns
steps: Explicitly start Voice Mode from Home, Chat, Study and Notebook. Conduct at least ten real spoken turns without tapping the mic again in each claimed supported language; confirm audible Supertonic and supported Kokoro fallback. Record cold/warm p50/p95 and actual heard replies.
expected: Listening/response loops work foreground; no stealth capture, missing-model false readiness, speaker echo command or language promise without actual recognition/audible evidence.

title: Interrupt/control
steps: Speak and touch Stop/Pause/Mute/Repeat/End while capturing, generating and playing. Interrupt offline and on a permitted hybrid turn; switch the TTS/reasoning model during playback and supersede queued controls.
expected: Old capture/generation/audio is cancelled, no duplicate action or stale resumed mic, mute is respected, and each control reflects observed state.

title: Audio/privacy/lifecycle
steps: Switch speaker/wired/BT/glasses routes; interrupt audio focus, background/foreground, rotate, sleep/restart and revoke permission. Repeat denied versus explicitly permitted cloud and 30-minute voice use.
expected: Route/focus/echo handling and visible mic state are correct; privacy gates hold; no surprise transmission; recovery, battery/thermal/RSS limits and accessibility are measured.

title: Catalog truth
steps: Inspect each displayed candidate against exact SHA/bytes/revision/format/quantization/provenance/license/source and actual native backend. Compare Compatible/Tested/Recommended/limitation badges by exact device, role and EN/RU/LV/PL.
expected: No runtime-init-only recommendation, unsupported format, English-only model advertised multilingual, or embedding advertised as generative vision. Update/runtime/artifact changes invalidate positive proof; negative quarantine is retained.

title: First-run/recovery
steps: On an isolated tester profile/device, install a functional suggested pack without HF browsing; pause/resume/cancel, interrupt process, test low storage safely, rollback, switch/remove and restart. Include gated/access-denied/token/import errors with test fixtures.
expected: Exact-owned files and shared models survive correctly; no lost unrelated partials or stale receipts; clear recovery and honest space/support limitations. Initial benchmark does not download new models automatically.

title: Role/language proof
steps: For each intended recommendation run exact installed role/language/backend fixtures, real STT/VAD and human audible TTS (all claimed languages), intent/tools/conversation, supported embedding/vision. Export source-bound evidence and recreate process before recommendation/apply.
expected: Fixtures and human quality agree; latest same-scope failures/clock rollback/ties supersede prior passes; package/install build identity and role assignments match. Interrupted/unsupported stays NOT_TESTED/UNSUPPORTED.

title: Actual paid listing
steps: In Play Console, review the paid base listing, intended tester availability, localized prices/taxes/countries and approximately USD4.99 target. Attach the released package/version/signature and reviewer evidence.
expected: Actual listing is paid and available in reviewed regions. A debug/sideload install or source price string is not store evidence. No feature pack or recurring Halo subscription is introduced.

title: Purchase/reinstall/refund
steps: An authorized human tester uses the actual purchasing Play account for initial install/access, uninstall/reinstall or replacement-device access, and applicable full-refund/support flow. Redact order/account/payment identifiers.
expected: Store delivery/access and refund/support behavior are demonstrated on the released build. No in-app base unlock, token/entitlement service or functional backend is invented. No automated payment or refund action.

title: Copy/legal/privacy
steps: Have the release owner review localized privacy, legal and support copy, provider-cost disclosure, support contact and current Play guidance.
expected: No recurring Halo charge or unlimited-third-party-credit promise; no assistant content/provider secret enters commerce. Record reviewer/date and approved copy, separately from legal advice.

title: Three central journeys
steps: On the exact installed build demonstrate repeatable physical sessions for ten-turn voice, safe typed/spoken ask→act→respond, and genuine Kids plus adult Study question/file/photo→hint/practice→Notebook/Canvas save/resume.
expected: All three central journeys have saved object/version/readback and human observations; no high-severity data loss, unauthorized action or fabricated cloud/offline state. Link #33/#36/#38/#54 evidence without substituting unit fixtures.

title: Consumer/accessibility
steps: Inspect Home composer/attachments/tools/orb, Settings/Advanced, Screen and Notebook/Canvas/Studio on phone/tablet, EN/RU/LV/PL, portrait/landscape and 200% text/TalkBack/reduced motion. Test Back and interruption around first-block flows.
expected: Approved BrandBook UX remains usable; important actions require no long scroll; no developer components/IDs leak; supported/in-development/disabled surfaces tell the truth.

title: Resilience/privacy matrix
steps: Use 8GB and available12GB+ hardware; verified CPU/GPU combinations, WiFi/offline, BT on/off, foreground/background, rotation/process death, TTS switch and safe thermal/low-memory tests. Complete setup/model-removal/permission-denial recovery and permitted/denied direct-provider paths.
expected: One concise PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_TESTED matrix records exact environment, source/APKs/models/language/provider/time and known limitations; no surprise functional server/cost or hidden request. Experimental unsupported surfaces are honestly gated.

title: Three semantic workflows
steps: Use three controlled fixture workflows: (1) existing note→structured edit/attachment→Canvas exact card, (2) exact file/PDF region→Study learner attempt/hint→saved note/resume, (3) Studio source→edit/export→Canvas/working-set handoff. Execute each by typed request and actual speech on-device and on a permitted Power route.
expected: Record exact target/saved IDs, versions, source hashes, semantic operation/approval/result truth and restart readback. Spoken/typed resolve the requested same canonical targets/outcomes; no navigation-only parity or synthetic text presented as speech.

title: Safety and operability
steps: Inspect actual ToolRegistry feature contracts/discovery, then deny restricted/destructive/external actions, revoke source/permission/capability, race revisions, cancel/interrupt and restart before acknowledgement; repeat duplicate/uncertain requests and Private/Power transitions.
expected: Existing approvals/Kids/OS/privacy policies hold; exact closed schemas and meaningful domain operations; truthful receipts and no automatic uncertain replay. Private never silently uploads workspace/screen/memory.

title: New ink controls
steps: Review halo_ink_status/document/start/stop/selection registration, bundled/runtime risks, WORKSPACE provenance, output quotas and same-interaction region guards. Verify pairing/certificate approval stays a protected human security act.
expected: Start needs fresh direct authority + exact source revision + qualified activation. Stroke/selection cannot call tools or grant cloud/app permission. Gated ink does not masquerade as completed physical #30 acceptance.
